comment: The Effect Editor's parameter categories and their controls (FX guide, Effects Parameter Reference, p.491-586), named as printed. 'min', 'max' and 'default' only where the text states them; 'kind' is slider, checkbox, color, menu, button or other; 'keyframeable': false where the reference says a parameter is not keyframeable (p.491); Where two parameters of a category share a name, the later one is stored under '<subcategory>: <name>' (ours; EffectParameter::name). 'ours' holds a slider's range where the reference gives none (ours), and options the text describes without listing (Pattern Generator's Axis menu, p.520); Pattern Generator's Position is two sliders, as its text says ("the horizontal (X) and vertical (Y) position", p.521).
